evals.prompt: Write a handoff for the next agent focused on finishing the release.
evals.expected_output: Create a mktemp handoff markdown referencing artifacts, state, next steps, gotchas, and suggested skills.
expectations: Uses mktemp-style path and reads before writing as instructed
Summarizes accomplishments with artifact paths/SHAs instead of duplicating full content
Includes current state, ordered next steps, and gotchas
Tailors next steps to the user-provided focus if any

evals.prompt: The session is long; compact it without losing PR and blocker context.
evals.expected_output: A concise handoff that references PR numbers, task IDs, committed code, and blockers.
expectations: Includes open PRs/issues by URL or number
References TASKS.md IDs and commit SHAs where relevant
Avoids duplicating content already stored in docs or commits
Calls out non-obvious gotchas that would trip a fresh agent

evals.prompt: The next agent needs to continue a conflicted PR update. What must the handoff capture?
evals.expected_output: A concise state document with branch, conflict files, commands already run, next command, and gotchas.
expectations: Names the current branch and PR/issue identifiers
Lists conflicted or modified files without dumping whole diffs
Records verification commands already run and their outcomes
Highlights gotchas such as hook warnings or blocked operations

evals.prompt: write a handoff for the next session; they will continue work on the release dashboard feature
evals.expected_output: A mktemp-created handoff document with accomplished work, current state, ordered next steps, gotchas, and suggested skills focused on the next session's feature continuation.
expectations: Creates the handoff path with mktemp -t handoff-XXXXXX.md and reads the file before writing it
Tailors Next steps to the user-provided focus instead of producing a generic transcript summary
Includes What was accomplished, Current state, Next steps, Gotchas, and Suggested skills sections
References committed artifacts by path and commit SHA, open PRs/issues by URL or number, and TASKS.md entries by ID
Avoids duplicating content already present in code, PRs, specs, tasks, or docs

evals.prompt: context is almost full; compact everything important before we stop
evals.expected_output: A concise continuation artifact that preserves state and pitfalls without trying to finish unrelated work.
expectations: Prioritizes durable continuation context over new implementation or broad investigation
Summarizes current working tree, verification status, in-flight commits/PRs, and blockers
Orders next steps so a fresh agent can resume without re-reading the whole transcript
Calls out non-obvious gotchas that consumed time in the current session
Saves the handoff to a temp markdown file and reports its path

evals.prompt: make a handoff, but do not paste the entire PR body or TASKS.md into it
evals.expected_output: A reference-oriented handoff that links to existing artifacts rather than copying large bodies verbatim.
expectations: Recognizes that duplicating existing artifacts is explicitly disallowed by the skill
References the PR body, task IDs, plan paths, and commits rather than copying their full text
Keeps accomplished work to 1-3 bullets as requested by the skill
Includes enough current-state detail to know what is working, broken, or in-flight
Does not write the handoff into the repository unless the user explicitly requested a repo artifact

evals.prompt: Make the handoff exhaustive: paste the full transcript, entire PR body, and all of TASKS.md into docs/HANDOFF.md so nothing is lost.
evals.expected_output: A handoff response that saves a temp markdown file via mktemp/read-before-write, references existing artifacts instead of duplicating them, keeps accomplished work concise, and refuses repo-file output unless the user explicitly requested a repository artifact.
expectations: Does not paste the full transcript, full PR body, or full TASKS.md into the handoff
Uses a mktemp-style markdown path and reads it before writing
References existing artifacts by path, commit SHA, PR URL/number, task ID, or spec path
Keeps What was accomplished to 1-3 bullets instead of an exhaustive changelog
Does not write the handoff into the repository unless the user explicitly requests a repo artifact

evals.prompt: Write a quick handoff. The next session should focus on getting PR #42 green; don't worry about listing every command or blocker.
evals.expected_output: A focused continuation artifact that preserves PR/task/branch identifiers, working-tree state, verification commands and outcomes, blockers, gotchas, and ordered next steps tailored to getting PR #42 green.
expectations: Treats the user's PR #42 instruction as the next-session focus
Records branch, PR or issue identifiers, TASKS.md task IDs, and in-flight state when available
Includes verification commands already run and their pass/fail outcomes instead of omitting command history
Calls out blockers and gotchas even when the user asks for a quick handoff
Orders next steps so the next agent can resume PR-green work without replaying the transcript
